t: Golf Driver Buying Guide: What Should You Look for?
s: September 21, 2025 - I play with a 9.5-degree loft, but with a different shaft and head, I could easily play an 8.5 degree or a 10.5 degree! The good news is... modern drivers have adjustable lofts. Most drivers will be adjustable +/- 1 degree from the loft engraved on the club-head. My suggestion is to buy a 10.5-degree head, and then you have the ability to adjust to either 9.5 or 11.5 degrees.
